gloss: to replace; to substitute; to rephrase

definitions.explanation: to put something in place of another

definitions.gloss: to rephrase; to put in different terms
definitions.explanation: to express the same idea using different words

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{部品|ぶひん}を{新|あたら}しいものに{置|お}き{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced the old parts with new ones.

examples.japanese: AをBに{置|お}き{換|か}えて{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: Think of it by substituting A with B.

examples.japanese: {変数|へんすう}を{値|あたい}に{置|お}き{換|か}える。
examples.english: Replace the variable with the value.

examples.japanese: {別|べつ}の{言葉|ことば}に{置|お}き{換|か}えると。
examples.english: To put it in other words.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{言葉|ことば}に{置|お}き{換|か}えて{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: Explain it by putting it in your own words.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{表現|ひょうげん}を{簡単|かんたん}な{言葉|ことば}に{置|お}き{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I rephrased the difficult expression in simple words.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

USAGE:
- AをBに{置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace A with B)
- {言葉|ことば}に{置|お}き{換|か}える (to put into words)

RELATED:
- {入|い}れ{替|か}える (to swap, exchange)
- {取|と}り{替|か}える (to exchange, replace)
- {言|い}い{換|か}える (to rephrase - speaking)
